clock_policy: A separate simulation clock advances to period end only after API persistence and independent readback. created_at and scored_at remain actual UTC timestamps. Calendar forecasts are never selected.
interval: 80 percent finite-sample rank of prior one-month absolute residuals from the same three-month mean; descriptive under dependence
limits: Six outcomes check the plumbing, not a calibrated production forecast claim.
The original study outcomes were already known when this supplemental check was registered.
Real December 2026 forecasts retain their calendar clock and remain pending.
outcome_generator: Previous observed month cost times (10000 + one common integer shock from -500 through 500 + one independent per-team integer shock from -1500 through 2000) / 10000, rounded to integer microdollars. Teams sorted before draws.
point_method: mean of the last three observed monthly costs, rounded to integer microdollars
purpose: Prospective simulated-month persistence and scoring check; not a new claim about real forecasting accuracy
sequence: compute forecasts from observed history only
POST every simulation forecast and independently read the durable unscored records
generate the new simulated outcomes in the close job
score all records in that simulation with the restricted close role
verify an idempotent second close and independent readback
